payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: YooKassa takes the payment — by card or any other method it offers. Only YooKassa sees your card details: Bronevik doesn't store them and only receives a masked card number for auto-renew.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, any time: turn auto-renew off in your account with one click. Plus keeps working until the end of the paid period, then your account returns to the free tier.

noAds.question: Will there be ads?
noAds.answer: No — with or without a subscription. Lesta's terms forbid ads in apps with paid features, and we like it better that way too. The project runs on subscriptions and donations.

data.question: Where does the data come from?
data.answer: Stats come from Lesta's public API and from our mod if you have it installed. Bronevik is a fan project not affiliated with Lesta. We never ask for your game password: sign-in is via Lesta ID only.

promo.question: How do I use a promo code?
promo.answer: Enter a discount code at checkout on this page. A free-days code is redeemed in your account under «Subscription» — the days are added to your current period.
